intro: China's radio landscape differs from America's in ways that matter before you start scanning. There is no NOAA-style continuous weather broadcast. Police and most municipal services run encrypted digital PDT and are unreachable. High-speed rail moved to digital GSM-R. What is left, and it is a lot, is aviation on the same international AM airband as everywhere else, conventional railway dispatch on 450 MHz, a genuinely useful licence-free walkie-talkie band at 409 MHz, provincial traffic radio that is the best road-condition source in the country, and a shortwave time station that is China's answer to WWV.
introz: 中国的无线电环境和美国有几个开始扫频前就该知道的差别：没有类似 NOAA 的连续气象广播；公安和多数市政部门使用加密的 PDT 数字系统，收不到；高铁已改用数字 GSM-R。剩下的内容依然很多：航空使用与全世界相同的国际 AM 波段；普速铁路的无线列调在 450 MHz；409 MHz 有一个真正好用的免执照对讲机频段；各省交通广播是全国最好的路况来源；还有一座相当于美国 WWV 的短波授时台。
warn: Receiving is not generally restricted in China, but transmitting requires a Chinese licence and type-approved equipment, and forwarding the content of other people's communications can be an offence. Never transmit on aviation, railway, marine or public-safety frequencies.
warnz: 在中国收听通常不受限制，但发射需要中国执照和经过型号核准的设备，转发他人通信内容也可能违法。切勿在航空、铁路、海事或公共安全频率上发射。

stations.z: 公众对讲机 1 频道
stations.d: 409.7500–409.9875 MHz, twenty channels at 12.5 kHz spacing, 0.5 W, no licence needed. This is where you will hear construction crews, restaurant staff, tour guides, delivery riders and hotel housekeeping across the entire country. The most consistently active band in urban China.
stations.dz: 409.7500–409.9875 MHz，20 个信道，间隔 12.5 kHz，0.5 瓦，无需执照。全国的工地、餐厅、导游、外卖骑手和酒店客房都在这个频段上。中国城市里最稳定活跃的频段。

stations.z: 公众对讲机 5 频道
stations.d: The low channels carry the most traffic because they are the factory defaults.
stations.dz: 低信道流量最大，因为它们是出厂默认设置。

stations.z: 公众对讲机 11 频道
公众对讲机 20 频道
stations.d: The quietest end of the band. Scan all twenty channels once in any city and you will get an instant sense of what is going on around you.
stations.dz: 频段里最安静的一端。在任何城市把 20 个信道扫一遍，马上就能感受到周围在发生什么。

stations.n: 公安 350 MHz — encrypted PDT digital
stations.z: 公安 350 MHz · PDT 数字加密
stations.d: Chinese public security uses the 350 MHz band with the domestic PDT digital standard, encrypted. Not decodable by any consumer receiver, and attempting to monitor it is not advisable. Listed so you do not spend an evening looking.
stations.dz: 中国公安使用 350 MHz 频段和国产 PDT 数字标准，且已加密。任何民用接收机都无法解码，也不建议尝试监听。列出来只是为了让你不必白花一晚上去找。

stations.z: 航空紧急频率
stations.d: The international distress frequency is identical worldwide, China included.
stations.dz: 国际遇险频率全球统一，中国也一样。

stations.d: Chinese ATC uses the same ICAO airband as everywhere else, with 25 kHz spacing. Published frequencies are in the CAAC AIP rather than on hobbyist sites, so the reliable method is to set the VX-6 to AM and scan this range near a terminal. Controllers work in Mandarin with domestic traffic and English with international.
stations.dz: 中国空管使用与全球一致的 ICAO 航空波段，间隔 25 kHz。具体频率公布在民航局航行资料汇编而非爱好者网站上，所以可靠的方法是把 VX-6 设为 AM，在航站楼附近扫这一段。管制员对国内航班用中文，对国际航班用英文。

stations.d: Approach and departure control, plus ATIS, generally sit in this range at Chinese airports.
stations.dz: 进场、离场管制以及 ATIS 在中国机场一般落在这一段。

stations.d: Enroute control. From a hilltop or a high floor you can hear aircraft at cruise altitude a very long way off.
stations.dz: 航路管制。在山顶或高楼层，能收到很远处巡航高度的航班。

stations.n: 无线列调 — conventional railway dispatch
stations.z: 无线列调 · 普速铁路调度
stations.d: Conventional (non-high-speed) Chinese railways use analog train-dispatch radio in the 450–460 MHz band, so it is receivable. Scan that range near any ordinary main line and you will find dispatcher and driver traffic. Worth doing at large stations and on slow overnight routes.
stations.dz: 中国普速铁路的无线列调使用 450–460 MHz 模拟制式，可以收听。在任何普速干线附近扫这一段，就能找到调度与司机的通话。在大站和夜间慢车线路上很值得一试。

stations.n: 无线列调 — paired uplink range
stations.z: 无线列调 · 上行配对频段
高铁 · GSM-R 数字系统
stations.d: China's high-speed network runs GSM-R in the 900 MHz band. It is digital cellular technology, not voice FM, and cannot be monitored on a scanner.
stations.dz: 中国高铁网络使用 900 MHz 频段的 GSM-R。它属于数字蜂窝技术，不是语音 FM，扫描机无法监听。

stations.z: 2 米 FM 呼叫频率（IARU 三区）
stations.d: China's amateur 2 m allocation is 144–146 MHz only, narrower than America's 144–148. Note that the American calling frequency of 146.520 is outside the band in China.
stations.dz: 中国业余 2 米频段只有 144–146 MHz，比美国的 144–148 窄。注意美国的呼叫频率 146.520 在中国属于超出频段。

stations.z: APRS 数据 · 一区与三区
stations.d: Different from the American 144.390. If you hear nothing on 144.390 in China, this is why.
stations.dz: 与美国的 144.390 不同。如果你在中国听 144.390 什么都没有，原因就在这里。

stations.z: 中继台下行 · 439 MHz 惯例
stations.d: Chinese UHF repeaters conventionally transmit around 439 MHz and listen 5 MHz lower around 434 MHz, which is a much larger shift than the ±600 kHz used in the US. Scan 439.000–440.000 in any large city to find local machines, then confirm the tone with the operating club.
stations.dz: 中国的 UHF 中继台通常在 439 MHz 附近下行、低 5 MHz 的 434 MHz 附近上行，这个频差比美国常用的 ±600 kHz 大得多。在任何大城市扫 439.000–440.000 就能找到本地中继，再向运营的俱乐部确认亚音频。

stations.n: 70 cm simplex — but expect heavy noise
stations.z: 70 厘米直通 · 但噪声很大
stations.d: 433.050–434.790 MHz is also China's short-range device band, shared with key fobs, doorbells and tyre sensors. Usable in the countryside, close to unusable in a city.
stations.dz: 433.050–434.790 MHz 同时也是中国的短距离设备频段，与车钥匙、门铃、胎压传感器共用。在乡村可用，在城市里几乎无法使用。

stations.z: 国际空间站语音下行
stations.d: The space station is the same frequency everywhere. Chinese schools take part in ARISS contacts too.
stations.dz: 空间站的频率全球一致。中国的学校也参与 ARISS 通联活动。

stations.z: 海事 16 频道 · 遇险与呼叫
stations.d: The international marine band is identical in Chinese waters. The Maritime Safety Administration announces on Ch 16 and then moves to a working channel for navigation warnings and weather.
stations.dz: 国际海事频段在中国水域完全一致。海事局在 16 频道预告后转到工作频道播发航行警告和气象。

stations.z: 海事 13 频道 · 船桥互通
海事 06 频道 · 船间通话
海事 12 频道 · 港务与船舶交通
stations.d: Chinese VTS centres use various channels between 06 and 14 depending on the port. Local assignments are published in navigation notices.
stations.dz: 中国的船舶交通管理中心根据港口不同，使用 06 至 14 之间的不同频道，具体分配公布在航行通告中。

stations.n: No continuous weather radio in China
stations.z: 中国没有连续气象广播
stations.d: There is no Chinese equivalent of NOAA Weather Radio on 162 MHz. Weather reaches the public through television, mobile alerts and provincial traffic radio. For marine forecasts, listen for the Maritime Safety Administration on Ch 16 announcing a working channel. In the mountains, provincial traffic radio is the practical substitute.
stations.dz: 中国没有对应 NOAA 那种 162 MHz 连续气象广播。气象信息通过电视、手机预警和各省交通广播发布。海上预报可在 16 频道等海事局通告工作频道。在山区，各省交通广播是现实的替代来源。

stations.z: BPM 短波授时台
stations.d: Broadcast from Pucheng in Shaanxi on 2.5, 5, 10 and 15 MHz. Standard time and frequency signals, China's counterpart to WWV in Colorado, and easily received across most of the country. Your VX-6 tunes down to 500 kHz so this works.
stations.dz: 由陕西蒲城发播，频率为 2.5、5、10、15 MHz，提供标准时间和标准频率信号，是中国对应美国 WWV 的授时台，在国内大部分地区都容易收到。VX-6 最低可调到 500 kHz，所以能收。

stations.z: BPM · 10 MHz
stations.d: Usually the strongest of the four during daytime.
stations.dz: 白天通常是四个频率里最强的一个。

stations.n: BPC 68.5 kHz — below the VX-6's range
stations.z: BPC 68.5 kHz · 低于 VX-6 下限
stations.d: The low-frequency time code from Shangqiu that synchronises radio-controlled clocks across China transmits at 68.5 kHz. The VX-6R stops at 500 kHz, so this one is out of reach.
stations.dz: 商丘发播的低频时码用于同步全国的电波钟，频率为 68.5 kHz。VX-6R 下限为 500 kHz，所以收不到。

stations.z: 国际空间站 APRS 转发
NOAA-19 气象卫星图传
stations.d: American weather satellites pass over China too and transmit in the clear. Also NOAA-15 on 137.620 and NOAA-18 on 137.9125.
stations.dz: 美国气象卫星同样经过中国上空，且为明码播发。另有 NOAA-15 137.620、NOAA-18 137.9125。

stations.z: 调频广播 · 扫 87.0–108.0 MHz
stations.d: Chinese FM occupies 87–108 MHz, the same as the US. The most useful station in any province is the 交通广播 (traffic radio) — road conditions, closures and weather, updated constantly, and far more current than any app when you are on a mountain road.
stations.dz: 中国调频广播使用 87–108 MHz，与美国相同。在任何省份最有用的都是交通广播——路况、封路和天气持续更新，在山路上比任何手机应用都及时。

stations.n: 中央人民广播电台 音乐之声 MusicRadio
stations.z: 中央人民广播电台 音乐之声
stations.d: The national music network, relayed on different local frequencies in each city. 90.0 MHz is the Beijing outlet.
stations.dz: 全国性音乐频率，各城市使用不同的本地频率转播，90.0 MHz 是北京的频率。

stations.n: 中国之声 — frequency varies by city
stations.z: 中国之声 · 各地频率不同
stations.d: The national news network is carried on a different frequency in every province, on both FM and medium wave. Sweep the band rather than looking for one number.
stations.dz: 全国新闻频率在每个省的频率都不同，调频和中波都有转播。建议整段搜索，而不是记一个数字。

stations.z: 中波 · 扫 531–1602 kHz
stations.d: Chinese medium wave uses 9 kHz channel spacing rather than America's 10 kHz. At night the band fills with high-power stations from across the country and from Japan, Korea and Southeast Asia. Genuinely one of the best AM listening environments anywhere.
stations.dz: 中国中波采用 9 kHz 间隔，而非美国的 10 kHz。入夜后整个频段挤满来自全国以及日本、韩国、东南亚的大功率电台，是全世界最好的中波收听环境之一。
